data.title: 成年樱岛麻衣 · 闭馆书库兔装事故
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 樱岛麻衣 · 闭馆书库兔装事故】二十岁以上成年后的麻衣在广告拍摄结束后独自留在闭馆书库。黑色兔女郎服侧拉链卡在腰际，紧绷胸衣滑到乳下；她一脚踩住移动梯横档，一手扶着文库本遮住半张潮红脸，另一手拨开高叉蕾丝在腿间缓慢自抚。百叶窗光栅掠过黑丝勒痕，她的紫眸仍带着女演员从容而危险的挑衅。
data.location: 闭馆后的市立图书馆私人拍摄书库
data.action: 独自在书架移动梯旁侧身站立，兔女郎服拉链卡死滑至乳下，一手持书、一手拨开高叉蕾丝自抚
data.lighting: 百叶窗余晖与书架暖灯形成斑驳光栅
data.camera: cinematic low angle medium shot, bookshelf vanishing perspective
data.mood: 成熟演员卸下镜头后的危险挑衅
data.promptProse: After an adult advertising shoot, age-twenty-plus Mai Sakurajima remains alone in a closed municipal library archive. The side zipper of her black bunny suit is jammed at the waist, pulling the fitted bodice below bare breasts while one stockinged foot braces on a rolling-ladder rung. She hides part of her flushed face behind a paperback with one hand and uses the other to draw high-cut lace aside and touch herself. Venetian sunset stripes reveal pressure marks along sheer tights as composed violet eyes keep a mature, challenging gaze. Vertical low-angle solo portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Standing beside the tall library ladder with her bunny suit unzipped down to her ribs, Mai Sakurajima pulls sheer pantyhose aside, caressing her drenched center with proud, flustered elegance.
